body.en:
Question B-002-009-008.

Why the correct answer is right: An azimuthal world map centred on your station is most useful for showing the bearing from you to any location.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "To allow computing the radiation angle to any location": Radiation angle is an antenna and propagation matter, not what this map primarily computes.
- sourceIndex 2: "To associate distances with optimal ionospheric region": Matching distance to an ionospheric region is not the main function identified here.
- sourceIndex 3: "To show the azimuth to meteor showers throughout the year": Meteor-shower azimuths are specialized and not the general amateur use being tested.
